```{r}
malig.labels <- readRDS("~/hpchome/malig.all.final.rds")

malig <- subset(asdf, barcode.unique %in% malig.labels)

table(malig$orig.ident)

df.malig <- as.data.frame(table(malig$orig.ident))

meta.malig <- malig@meta.data
meta.malig$orig.merge <- ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% c("S72", "S73"), "S72",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% c("S74", "S75"), "S74",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 153:156), "S153",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 157:161), "S157",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 162:165), "S162",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 166:169), "S166",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 170:175), "S170",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 176:181), "S176",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 182:187), "S182",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 188:192), "S188",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 216:223), "S216",
                      ifelse(meta.malig$orig.ident %in% paste0("S", 225:232), "S225",
                      meta.malig$orig.ident))))))))))))

malig@meta.data <- meta.malig

df.malig <- as.data.frame(table(malig$orig.merge))

setdiff(ctcl.pts, df.malig$Var1)

df.malig.ss <- subset(df.malig, Freq > 99)

malig.ss <- subset(malig, orig.merge %in% df.malig.ss$Var1)

malig.ss <- r2sample_seurat(malig.ss, group_var = "orig.merge", n = 1000, barcode_column = "barcode.unique")
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(malig.ss) <- "RNA"
malig.ss@assays$sketch <- NULL

malig.ss <- FindVariableFeatures(malig.ss)
vf <- VariableFeatures(malig.ss)
vf.ss <- setdiff(vf, c(ig_genes, tcr_genes, ribo, hemoglobin))

malig.ss <- ScaleData(malig.ss)
malig.ss <- RunPCA(malig.ss, npcs = 30)
malig.ss <- RunUMAP(malig.ss, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(malig.ss, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umap")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(malig.ss, group.by = "GEO.Cohort", reduction = "umap")
```



```{r}
malig.ss <- RunHarmony(malig.ss, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "RNA", reduction.save = "harmony", dims = 1:30, ncores = 30)
malig.ss <- RunUMAP(malig.ss, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony", reduction.name = "umap.harmony.orig.ident")

malig.ss <- RunHarmony(malig.ss, group.by.vars = "GEO.Cohort", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "RNA", reduction.save = "harmony.geo", dims = 1:30, ncores = 30)
malig.ss <- RunUMAP(malig.ss, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony.geo", reduction.name = "umap.harmony.geo")


DimPlot(malig.ss, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umap")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(malig.ss, group.by = "GEO.Cohort", reduction = "umap")

DimPlot(malig.ss, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umap.harmony.orig.ident")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(malig.ss, group.by = "GEO.Cohort", reduction = "umap.harmony.orig.ident")

DimPlot(malig.ss, group.by = "orig.ident", reduction = "umap.harmony.geo")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(malig.ss, group.by = "GEO.Cohort", reduction = "umap.harmony.geo")
```

```{r}
seu <- malig.ss

meta.seu <- seu@meta.data
meta.seu <- meta.seu[, c(1:3,18:26,36)]

seu@meta.data <- meta.seu
seu.list <- SplitObject(seu, split.by = "orig.merge")
seu.list.ss <- seu.list[1:5]

geneNMF.programs <- multiNMF(seu.list, assay="RNA", k=4:6, min.exp = 0.05)

geneNMF.metaprograms <- getMetaPrograms(geneNMF.programs,
                                        metric = "cosine",
                                        specificity.weight = 3,
                                        weight.explained = 0.6,
                                        nMP=10, max.genes = 100, min.confidence = 0.5, remove.empty = T)

plotMetaPrograms(geneNMF.metaprograms,
                       similarity.cutoff = c(0.1,1))

mps <- geneNMF.metaprograms[["metaprograms.genes"]]

lapply(geneNMF.metaprograms$metaprograms.genes, head)
```


```{r}
VlnPlot(t.cells, features = "DDX55", group.by = "celltype.malig", pt.size = .01, alpha = .01)
```



```{r}
top_p <- lapply(geneNMF.metaprograms$metaprograms.genes, function(program) {
  runGSEA(program, universe=rownames(seu), category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP")
})

mp.genes <- geneNMF.metaprograms$metaprograms.genes
seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu, features = mp.genes, ncores=32, name = "")

meta.malig.ss <- malig.ss@meta.data
meta.seu <- seu@meta.data

meta.cbind <- cbind(meta.seu, meta.malig.ss)
meta.cbind$Path.Stage.bin <- ifelse(meta.cbind$Path.Stage %in% c("IA", "IB", "IIA"), "Early_Stage",
                            ifelse(meta.cbind$Path.Stage %in% c("IIB", "IIIA", "IIIB", "IVA", "IVB", "IV"),
                              "Late_Stage", "Control"))

seu@meta.data <- meta.cbind

VlnPlot(seu, features=names(mp.genes), group.by = "Dx", pt.size = .01, alpha = .01, raster = F)
VlnPlot(seu, features=names(mp.genes), group.by = "Tissue", pt.size = .01, alpha = .01, raster = F)
VlnPlot(seu, features=names(mp.genes), group.by = "Path.Stage.bin", pt.size = .01, alpha = .01, raster = F)

matrix <- seu@meta.data[,names(mp.genes)]

dimred <- as.matrix(matrix)

colnames(dimred) <- paste0("MP_",seq(1, ncol(dimred)))
seu@reductions[["MPsignatures"]] <- new("DimReduc",
                                         cell.embeddings = dimred,
                                         assay.used = "RNA",
                                         key = "MP_",
                                         global = FALSE)

seu <- RunUMAP(seu, reduction="MPsignatures", dims=1:length(seu@reductions[["MPsignatures"]]),
               metric = "euclidean", reduction.name = "umap_MP")

DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap_MP", group.by = "orig.ident")+NoLegend()
DimPlot(seu, reduction = "umap_MP", group.by = "GEO.Cohort")

FeaturePlot(seu, features = names(mp.genes), reduction = "umap_MP", ncol=4) &
  scale_color_viridis(option="B") &
   theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.text=element_blank(), axis.ticks=element_blank())
```











```{r}
seu.list.ss <- seu.list[1:10]

seu.list.ss <- lapply(seu.list.ss, function(x){
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x)
  return(x)
})

hvg_freq <- table(unlist(lapply(seu.list.ss, VariableFeatures)))
hvg_combined <- names(sort(hvg_freq, decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(2000, length(hvg_freq))]


geneNMF.programs.ss <- multiNMF(seu.list.ss, assay="RNA", k=4:6, min.exp = 0.05, center = F, scale = T, hvg = hvg_combined)


geneNMF.metaprograms.ss <- getMetaPrograms(geneNMF.programs.ss,
                                        metric = "cosine",
                                        specificity.weight = 3,
                                        weight.explained = 0.6,
                                        nMP=10, 
                                        max.genes = 100, 
                                        min.confidence = 0.5, 
                                        remove.empty = T)

plotMetaPrograms(geneNMF.metaprograms.ss,
                       similarity.cutoff = c(0.1,1))

lapply(geneNMF.metaprograms.ss$metaprograms.genes, head)


mps.ss<- geneNMF.metaprograms.ss[["metaprograms.genes"]]


```
